What we do

We structure the operation before looking for the capital.

Before any application, we make the company, its owners and its partners ready for the credit they are seeking.

Banking eligibility

We diagnose and resolve credit restrictions on the company and on its owners before they reach a financial institution.

Credit structuring

Working capital and corporate credit, structured to fit the company's cash flow and the criteria of each institution.

Property-backed credit

Home Equity for owners who want to use real estate as a lever for the business, always subject to the lender's own analysis.

Network

A broad network of financial institutions, in Brazil and abroad.

We connect prepared companies to the institutions best suited to each operation, and we are open to conversations with institutional partners and investors.

Prepared files, clear information

Institutions receive complete, well-organized cases, which saves analysis time on both sides.

Discretion

Sensitive financial data is handled with care and shared only as the operation requires.

No promises

We never promise approval, rate, amount or timing. Every decision belongs to the financial institution.

Contact

Let us talk about your institution or your project.

For partnerships, institutional contact or investor inquiries, write to our team. We reply in English and Portuguese.

Credit structuring and financial operations for companies, assets and projects.

Acrópole Capital advises on and structures credit operations. We are not a financial institution and do not lend directly. Every operation is subject to the analysis, criteria and final decision of the responsible financial institution. Nothing on this page constitutes an offer, a firm proposal, investment advice or a promise of approval.
